infographic.title: How a Rotameter Measures Flow
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how a rotameter float rises in a tapered tube until the forces balance and the flow is read on the scale
steps: Fluid moves up through a tube that widens toward the top.
Drag and buoyancy push the float up against its weight.
As the float rises, the annular area around it gets larger.
The float settles where the open area passes the flow, and you read the scale.
